TOOLING BURST FL-6c — dance layers: no rectangular clipping; tongue size trim (Run C-5, FIRE LANE; conductor R-C5-136, defect F-C5-43 on the v43-r1 render). task_id "FL-6c".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4h, FL-6, FL-6b and the new row "FL-6c — dance layers unclipped" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (`_emit_flame_dance` and the layer construction in the burst_v2 pieces phase / the painted travel / the G2 licks: how L2/L3 textures, regions, offsets and scales are built), export/effect_kit.py (flame_dance validation, the layer bake if any), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v3/kit.json, fire_bolt_e1_B/kit.json, blackwater_cocktail_e3/kit.json, runs/C-5/cliffside_v43/ (staged, READ ONLY — the rendered defect came from it), tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only; a headless 1080p gl_compatibility CAPTURE of the east cast IS required here (probe_cast_dir.gd style) because the defect is rendered.

THE DEFECT (conductor, v43 east cast frames 26-40, runs/C-5/t3/FL1-fire-8dir-v43/v43_dance_consecutive.png): the L2/L3 dance layers show HARD RECTANGULAR EDGES — straight horizontal/vertical cut-offs through the flame (a square block of orange at the lower right at f26; clipped tongues at f34/f36). Cause to confirm: the layer sprites sample a region rect / atlas bounds (or a baked layer canvas) that does not cover the layer after its scale + translation + rotation, so the sprite is clipped at the texture edge. FIX: (a) build each dance layer's texture on a canvas padded by ≥ (max jitter_px + rotation reach + (scale−1)×half-extent) on every side, or draw the layer with the FULL texture and no region rect, with `centered` pivots at the body pivot; (b) assert in the export that no dance layer's drawn bounds exceed its texture bounds at the extreme of the jitter ranges; (c) the front-layer tongues: `tongue_scale` [1.3,1.7] → [1.1,1.4], `tongue_root_radius_factor` 1.25 → 1.15 (the burst read ~5 BH; keep the legibility: tongues still ≥ 60 % outside the base). PROOF: a 1080p headless capture of the east cast at ages 24, 28, 32, 36 into runs/C-5/t3/FL-6c/capture/, and an EDGE TEST on those frames: within the burst's bbox, no run of ≥ 24 consecutive pixels along a row or column where the flame alpha/colour steps from painted to background on a perfectly straight line (a rect-clip signature) — report the longest straight step run per frame (must be < 24 px); plus the FL-6 legibility numbers re-measured. Byte identity: 15 kits untouched; the three FL-6 kits' kit.json only; primitives byte-identical; export exit 0; compat import exit 0; named tests green; remaining reds NAMED; byte locks by the FL-1b rule.
DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any kit except the three FL-6 kits' kit.json, any spec except runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json (dance fields), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-6c/; fixtures/ only for byte locks. No Godot GUI. No deploy. Confine Godot logs to runs/C-5/t3/FL-6c/.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-6c"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
